pressRelease.headline: Spellful Launches Free Witchcraft & Intuitive Wellness App for iOS and Android
pressRelease.subheadline: New app combines astronomically accurate astrology, 78-card tarot with original artwork, and a private grimoire in one cohesive spiritual companion
pressRelease.body:
Spellful, the witchcraft and intuitive wellness platform, today announced the launch of its free mobile application for iOS and Android. The app brings together personalized daily horoscopes, a complete 78-card tarot deck with original custom artwork, a moon ritual planner, and a private digital grimoire — making it the most comprehensive witchcraft companion available on mobile.

The Spellful app delivers personalized daily horoscopes calculated directly from each user's birth chart using VSOP87 planetary ephemeris data, the same astronomical standard used by professional astrologers. The moon phase engine, built on the Meeus Chapter 47 perturbation series, achieves ±2 minute accuracy for all lunar calculations — a level of precision rarely found in consumer wellness applications.

"We built Spellful for practitioners of every level," said the Spellful team. "Whether you are drawing your first tarot card or have practiced for decades, we wanted to create a space that takes your craft seriously — with real astronomical accuracy, original artwork, and tools that grow with your practice."

The app's tarot deck features original custom artwork for all 78 cards, with five spread layouts including the Celtic Cross, New Moon, and Shadow Work spreads. The Moon Ritual Planner offers 48 rituals aligned to each lunar phase, while Spellful Academy provides 22 structured lessons across 9 topics for practitioners looking to deepen their knowledge.

Spellful also includes a personal Grimoire — a private digital Book of Shadows — with a 49-herb reference library, dream journal, and shadow work prompts. A moderated community connects practitioners worldwide through boards, polls, and Q&A discussions.

The app is free to download with no advertisements. Push notifications for moon phases and practice reminders are available with user opt-in.
